argument: A common terminal action history must give a move path through cells open in every remaining model. For every model pair this common-open graph has no start-goal path. Observations have no effects; removing them cannot create such a path. Thus each terminal history covers at most one model. A binary observation tree of sensor depth at most four has at most 16 leaves, fewer than the 25 initial models. All models require completion.
scope: Domain-specific independent certificate, not a timed generic baseline or novel bound.
